question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The efforts will be in __vain__ if we do not submit the project report on time.
solution:
The correct answer is "**useless.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the bracketed word and the given word:
 
 
• **The word "vain" means ineffective or futile.**(व्यर्थ)

 
 
• Example: I was singing in a vain effort to cheer him up. 
 
 
 
 
 
• **The synonym for "vain" is "useless", which means having no practical purpose or value.**(बेकार)
 
 
• Example: Its useless to write the assignment now.
 
 
 
• Using the correct synonym is important for clear and effective communication.
 
• In this sentence, the correct option is "useless" because it accurately conveys the meaning of the original sentence.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In option 2 "**careless**" means not taking enough care or attention.(लापरवाह)
 
• In option 3 "**delightful**" means giving great pleasure or delight.(आनंदमय)
 
• In option 4 "**sensible"** means having or showing good sense or judgment.(समझदार)
